maintenance_led.reason: Sells AutoCAD, Revit, Fusion design software by subscription; revenue is software subscriptions, not repair or servicing of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private architecture, engineering, construction, manufacturing and media firms paying software subscriptions; government is not the main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling subscriptions to its own products like AutoCAD, Revit and Fusion; acquisitions are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: AutoCAD, Revit and Inventor are embedded in customers' design workflows and file formats; switching means retraining and project disruption.
